lessons.title: Controller is adjudicator, not Writer relay
lessons.source_event: Repeated Writer PASS claims later reopened by independent/Owner review
lessons.root_cause: Writer evidence was accepted too semantically
lessons.policy_change: Independent Controller review mandatory before promotion

lessons.title: Handler presence is not interaction completeness
lessons.source_event: W03 Runs/Structure tabs and other controls selected without meaningful view change
lessons.root_cause: tests asserted selectors/handlers instead of state transitions

lessons.title: Mapping PASS is not implementation completion
lessons.source_event: W01/W02 ZERO_ORPHAN PASS coexisted with PARTIAL/MISSING/runtime-unproven rows
lessons.root_cause: destination completeness confused with capability completion

lessons.title: Source-handled is not production-proven
lessons.source_event: Writer-B 67/67 source-handled while runtime/browser/DB evidence remained open
lessons.root_cause: source mutation count interpreted as end-to-end completion
lessons.policy_change: Evidence-class non-collapse and precise completion wording

lessons.title: High-value source preserved does not mean micro-details enforced
lessons.source_event: W03 world-class proposal remained in Library but some terminal/workbench details were not in current acceptance rows
lessons.root_cause: proposal distilled to macro decisions without full current reconciliation

lessons.title: Direct donor/source required for behavioral inheritance
lessons.source_event: Accepted Library summary/crosswalk did not ensure full W03 interaction inheritance
lessons.root_cause: summaries substituted for executable donor mechanics
lessons.policy_change: Read direct bytes/source for behavior-sensitive decisions

lessons.title: Global mechanics must be checked across all surfaces
lessons.source_event: Guidance, spatial, shell and other mechanics appeared inconsistently across W03 surfaces

lessons.title: Current Git branch topology is part of source truth
lessons.source_event: W03 mapping initially risked using main while Work3/Work4/surface branches carried current value
lessons.root_cause: conceptual roadmap treated as physical destination truth
lessons.policy_change: Fresh branch/SHA reconciliation before Production mapping

lessons.title: Net-new Production owner is Controller decision
lessons.source_event: Linked Sticky Notes rows correctly stopped when exact destination owner was absent

lessons.title: Exact-route block does not end visual assurance
lessons.root_cause: route proof and candidate-bound visual proof were previously conflated
lessons.policy_change: Keep route blocked; continue hash-bound fallback visual review

lessons.title: Owner hands-on review can reopen a passing Blueprint
lessons.source_event: W03 v3.3.1 manual review exposed theme, Runs, Shell, relation and inheritance gaps
lessons.root_cause: automated suites lacked professional workflow oracles
lessons.policy_change: Owner review observations become formal findings/tests before design adjudication

lessons.title: Do not restart strong lineage because new gaps appear
lessons.source_event: W03 v3.3/v3.3.1 retained significant verified value while requiring correction
lessons.root_cause: risk of broad rewrite losing verified fixes
lessons.policy_change: Same-lineage bounded successor correction unless conflict proves restart necessary

lessons.title: Colab/runtime should come after safe source-contract exhaustion
lessons.source_event: W01/W02 still had resolvable C024/range-style contracts before runtime evidence
lessons.root_cause: expensive environment testing can expose issues that could be resolved statically first

lessons.title: Fake provider/runtime output is forbidden
lessons.source_event: W03 shell realism and provider boundaries
lessons.root_cause: visual prototypes can appear operational without causal backend
lessons.policy_change: Blueprint proves UX/session/provider boundary; Production proves real I/O causality

lessons.title: Controller handoff must contain decisions + lessons, not only current files
lessons.source_event: W03 recovery handoff strong but workspace-specific and historical
lessons.root_cause: future Controller can recover state yet miss generalized governance lessons
lessons.policy_change: Handoff v2 requires source map, decision register, lessons, gates, evidence limits, exact next actions

lessons.title: A contract migration must retire stale product-truth denials
lessons.source_event: Writer-B v1.1.5 implemented V4 inline range styles while BlockContextMenu still said those styles were not admitted
lessons.root_cause: source-contract tests proved the new owner but did not scan user-facing legacy denial copy
lessons.policy_change: Every contract supersession must run stale-denial/deprecated-truth search and reconcile visible disabled controls/messages
